definition: Systems or services that observe, forecast, store, process or provide information on climate, weather, natural hazards or associated exposure and vulnerability. Includes applications that turn climate or weather information into specific adaptation advice or decisions, such as farm advice, water allocation, investment prioritisation and targeting of climate-shock support. Includes environmental monitoring only when its climate or hazard relevance is explicit. Producing an assessment or analytical map is cra; maintaining an information system is this measure; hazard alerts are ews. Includes laws, regulations, standards and plans specifically about climate information. Excludes emissions accounting and generic environmental data without a stated climate or hazard connection.
